description: The terraforming station is a regular grid of rectangular growing beds and work bays inside a metal-walled control room. A bright circular transport platform sits in the middle of the grid, with narrow walkways leading around it. Screens and environmental displays line the upper wall beneath a Terraforming Station sign. Several corner bays hold green plants and equipment, contrasting with the dark beds and grey floor panels. Warm wall lights frame the room, while the blue platform and display screens supply the brightest colour. The whole scene is arranged around controlled growing spaces rather than an outdoor field.
